name: U.S. Bank Cash+® Visa Signature® Card

localized_names.en: U.S. Bank Cash+® Visa Signature® Card

apr.notes: 0% intro APR on purchases and balance transfers for the first 15 billing cycles. After that, a variable APR applies (amount not displayed on page). Balance transfer fee applies.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee applies; confirm current rate in Cardmember Agreement.

base_rate.description: 1% cash back on all other eligible purchases.

categories.label: 5% cash back on two categories you choose each quarter (first $2,000 in combined eligible purchases each quarter, then 1%)
2% cash back on one everyday category you choose each quarter (gas stations and EV charging, grocery stores, or restaurants)
5% cash back on prepaid travel (air, hotel and car reservations booked directly in the U.S. Bank Travel Center)

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back can be redeemed as a statement credit, a rewards card, or directly deposited into a U.S. Bank checking or savings account. Choose and activate Cash+ Categories each quarter to earn.

signup_bonus.description: Earn a $250 rewards bonus after you spend $1,000 in eligible purchases within the first 90 days of account opening.

benefits.title: Cash-back deals
benefits.description: Personalized cash-back offers based on previous spending, accessible through the U.S. Bank Mobile App or online banking.

benefits.title: ExtendPay® Plan
benefits.description: Pay over time with a U.S. Bank ExtendPay® Plan; new cardmembers receive a $0 fee offer on ExtendPay Plans opened in the first 60 days after account opening.

benefits.title: Flexible redemption
benefits.description: Redeem cash back as a statement credit, a rewards card, or a direct deposit into a U.S. Bank checking or savings account.

notes: No annual fee. 5% and 2% categories are chosen and activated each quarter; the 5% categories are capped at the first $2,000 in combined eligible purchases each quarter (then 1%). Annual fee amount and APR variable rate not displayed on page (shown as placeholders).
